visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of female hands with a red string on the wrist are seen adjusting a small beige suitcase inside a larger silver one. The silver suitcase is open on a light wooden floor and is overflowing with blue denim jeans and a white cotton shirt. The room has soft, natural indoor lighting coming from the side. (2) The scene cuts to an exterior view of an IKEA store building with its signature large blue and yellow logo against a grey sky. Below the logo, glass doors are marked 'Sortie' in white text. The camera then focuses on a woman's face with dark shoulder-length hair and a tan coat, looking directly into the lens while walking through a bright retail environment. (3) Various large IKEA storage bags in white, teal, and black-and-white patterns are shown hanging on metal racks. A hand with pink nail polish flips a price tag labeled 'DIMPA' showing 2.99 Euros. The bags are made of a woven plastic texture and are displayed under bright, flat retail lighting. (4) The woman's hands are shown stuffing pink and brown clothing items into a large, semi-transparent woven plastic bag on a wooden floor. She zips the black zipper shut. The scene transitions to an airport check-in area where the bag is placed on a black rubber conveyor belt scale, displaying a red digital weight of 17.2 kg. (5) In the final phase, the camera captures the airport luggage claim area with a rotating black carousel. The clear IKEA bag and a brown suitcase with stickers move slowly past. The lighting is bright and industrial, reflecting off the tiled floor and metal components of the conveyor system.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 出門旅行行李炸開. (2) [Subtitle]: 帶不回來怎麼辦. (3) [Subtitle]: 方法一 一開始就帶箱中箱 可以一分為二. (4) [Logo]: IKEA. [Subtitle]: 方法二 在當地找到IKEA. (5) [Subtitle]: 因為行李袋太貴了 (一個約1700臺幣起) 所以我現在來IKEA 找有沒有合適的 可以托運的袋子. (6) [Subtitle]: 可以選擇像 這些的托運袋 這個只要2.99塊錢 (臺幣104元) 真是太划算了 超級大的. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個是4.99元 (臺幣174元) 這個也很強壯. (8) [Subtitle]: 這個袋子真的超級能裝的 幾乎所有的衣服 都已經裝進去 床單、鞋子、書 耐摔的都放進去. (9) [Subtitle]: 準備托運 裝滿才17公斤. (10) [Subtitle]: 下飛機後順利在轉盤上 看到我的行李袋了 忘了把拉鍊 鎖頭鎖起來 還好東西都還在呢.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice starts narrating in a fast, energetic tone with rising intonations. An upbeat acoustic guitar track with a steady drum beat begins at a moderate volume. There is a slight background hum of a quiet indoor room. (2) A sharp rustling sound of plastic and fabric occurs as the speaker discusses packing suitcases. The BGM tempo remains constant at roughly 120 BPM. (3) A distinct 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of price tags on screen. The female voice continues with increased arousal, emphasizing the cost-effectiveness of the solution. (4) A long, continuous sound of a zipper sliding shut and more loud plastic crinkling is heard as a bag is sealed. The vocal rate is high, matching the physical packing speed. (5) A muffled percussive thud is heard as the bag is placed on an airport scale, followed by the mechanical hum of a conveyor belt. The ambient noise floor shifts to include distant terminal echoes. (6) The mechanical whirring of a luggage carousel dominates the background. The female voice concludes with a relieved, happy tone as she identifies her bag. The BGM fades out gradually.
